text:
The 2021 tree-cover loss is **corroborated under the tool’s rule**: a later year has been observed, and the JRC reference mapped 98% of the event area as forest in 2020. The earlier 2022 assessment could not yet meet the rule because no later year had been observed.

The event covers **81.3 hectares**, or **2.23%** of the property. Uruguay’s 2021 forest map classifies 68.1 hectares as planted pine forest and 13.2 hectares as outside mapped forest; none is mapped as native forest.

A further 37.3 hectares of 2021 loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event. The evidence does not establish the cause of the loss.
